question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a blue ball, Eve has a grey ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a yellow ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) white ball
(C) orange ball
(D) blue ball
(E) grey ball
(F) green ball
(G) yellow ball
solution:
Ball colors in each row are listed for Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: pink | white | orange | blue | grey | green | yellow
1. Alice and Gertrude swap: yellow | white | orange | blue | grey | green | pink
2. Dave and Bob swap: yellow | blue | orange | white | grey | green | pink
3. Fred and Gertrude swap: yellow | blue | orange | white | grey | pink | green
4. Gertrude and Fred swap: yellow | blue | orange | white | grey | green | pink
5. Eve and Alice swap: grey | blue | orange | white | yellow | green | pink
6. Eve and Alice swap: yellow | blue | orange | white | grey | green | pink
7. Gertrude and Dave swap: yellow | blue | orange | pink | grey | green | white
Claire has the orange ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
